comps.spec: LED light strings, 50–300 bulbs: mains strings, or low-voltage battery and solar strings that run on 3–4.5V
comps.loc: Boxes and tubs, or on eaves and trees

comps.spec: Blower that keeps each inflatable up: fed from a 12V plug-in adapter on the Gemmy 13-E-DTC (the fan's own rating isn't printed) or from 120V mains on the Gemmy AB-2-E — read the label first; a ready blower for a forge or stove
Low-voltage plug-in adapters for inflatables and light displays: 12V 1.5A on the Gemmy 13-E-DTC, 5.9V 1.5A on the SVI 12 ft skeleton — read the label
Small solar panels on solar string lights and stakes, about 2–6V, usually with one AA NiMH cell underneath
CR2032 coin cells in LED tea lights and small light-up decorations
Ripstop nylon from inflatables — light waterproof fabric
Outdoor extension cords and lots of thin twin wire
Slow motors in some animated figures and rotating stands (none documented in the logged models, so check yours)
Plug fuse on mains light strings and inflatables: 3A, 125V in the GE 50-light sets and 5A, 125V in the Gemmy AB-2-E — replace only with the same rating
One AA NiMH cell (1.2V, 600 mAh on the Glitzhome string) under the panel of solar string lights — charge it only on a NiMH charger
Four 1.5V C cells in big animated figures such as the SVI 12 ft skeleton (not included; the 5.9V adapter can power it instead)
LCD eyes in big animated figures such as the SVI 12 ft skeleton, switched from a button on the pelvis (on, 6-hour timer, off); no ratings printed
